### **Sie möchten endlich mit Erfolg abnehmen und Ihre Gesundheit ist Ihnen wichtig?**

**Mit Bodymed können Sie sich sicher sein!**
Das Ernährungsprogramm ist durch viele Studien mit insgesamt fast 3.000 Teilnehmern bestätigt. Die
Ergebnisse zeigen den Erfolg: Nicht nur für Übergewicht und Adipositas auch zur Vorbeugung und
unterstützenden Behandlung von Begleiterkrankungen, wie Typ-2-Diabetes oder Bluthochdruck, ist das
Bodymed-Ernährungsprogramm geeignet.

Darüber hinaus wird das Bodymed-Ernährungsprogramm in der aktuellen S3-Leitlinie* zur „Prävention
und Therapie der Adipositas“ von den nationalen Fachgesellschaften als erfolgreiche Maßnahme zur
Gewichtsabnahme empfohlen. Dies ist für Bodymed die höchste Qualitätsauszeichnung.

Verschiedene Studien zeigen einen mittleren Gewichtsverlust von 10 Kilogramm innerhalb eines Jahres.
Mit herkömmlichen Diäten, ohne Einsatz von Mahlzeitenersatz, sind nur maximal 5 Kilogramm zu
schaffen.

Außerdem geht der überwiegende Teil meist auf das Konto der Muskulatur und des Körperwassers, so
dass der Jojo-Effekt leider vorprogrammiert ist. Mit dem Bodymed-Ernährungsprogramm ist das anders –
Sie sind nachhaltig erfolgreich.

Ihr persönlicher Bodymed-Berater vor Ort wird Sie Schritt für Schritt begleiten. Gemeinsam planen
Sie den optimalen Weg zu Ihrem Zielgewicht. Ihr Wohl und Ihre Gesundheit liegen Bodymed am Herzen.

### **Sie möchten endlich mit Erfolg abnehmen und Ihre Gesundheit ist Ihnen wichtig?**

**Mit Bodymed können Sie sich sicher sein!**
Das Ernährungsprogramm ist durch viele Studien mit insgesamt fast 3.000 Teilnehmern bestätigt. Die
Ergebnisse zeigen den Erfolg: Nicht nur für Übergewicht und Adipositas auch zur Vorbeugung und
unterstützenden Behandlung von Begleiterkrankungen, wie Typ-2-Diabetes oder Bluthochdruck, ist das
Bodymed-Ernährungsprogramm geeignet.

Darüber hinaus wird das Bodymed-Ernährungsprogramm in der aktuellen S3-Leitlinie* zur „Prävention
und Therapie der Adipositas“ von den nationalen Fachgesellschaften als erfolgreiche Maßnahme zur
Gewichtsabnahme empfohlen. Dies ist für Bodymed die höchste Qualitätsauszeichnung.

Verschiedene Studien zeigen einen mittleren Gewichtsverlust von 10 Kilogramm innerhalb eines Jahres.
Mit herkömmlichen Diäten, ohne Einsatz von Mahlzeitenersatz, sind nur maximal 5 Kilogramm zu
schaffen.

Außerdem geht der überwiegende Teil meist auf das Konto der Muskulatur und des Körperwassers, so
dass der Jojo-Effekt leider vorprogrammiert ist. Mit dem Bodymed-Ernährungsprogramm ist das anders –
Sie sind nachhaltig erfolgreich.

Ihr persönlicher Bodymed-Berater vor Ort wird Sie Schritt für Schritt begleiten. Gemeinsam planen
Sie den optimalen Weg zu Ihrem Zielgewicht. Ihr Wohl und Ihre Gesundheit liegen Bodymed am Herzen.

With a passion for innovation and injury prevention, we provide a full range of solutions designed
to relieve pain, enhance performance, and support recovery. From runners and athletes to everyday
individuals seeking comfort and mobility, our trusted brands—like ProStretch®, Tuli’s®, Cho-Pat®,
and 2Toms®—offer proven products backed by science and used by professionals worldwide. Whether
you're overcoming an injury or looking to stay active, Medi-Dyne is here to help you move better,
feel better, and live better.

Introducing Altivera

# Elevating Performance. Advancing Recovery.

Altivera develops innovative medical technologies that help patients recover faster, restore
mobility, and live with less pain.

Backed by decades of experience, we support providers with reliable, patient-centered solutions
across every stage of recovery.

[Explore Our Products][7]

## Our Solutions

Altivera solutions support recovery through clinically proven, non-invasive solutions designed to
help patients manage pain, restore mobility, and continue progressing between clinical visits.

[
[Electrotherapy]

### Electrotherapy

Technologies designed to help relieve pain, stimulate muscle re-education, and support functional
recovery.

][8][
[Hot/Cold Compression]

### Hot/Cold Compression

Compression and temperature therapy designed to reduce inflammation, relieve discomfort, and promote
healing during recovery.

][9][
[Bracing & Traction]

### Bracing & Traction

Orthopedic support systems designed to stabilize joints, protect healing tissue, and support
recovery following injury or surgery.

][10]

## Built to Last. Guided by Best Practices.

Altivera develops advanced technologies and high-quality products to support patients throughout the
recovery process. Our solutions are built for real-world use, helping patients regain mobility and
progress confidently in their rehabilitation.

[See More Products][11]

## Built to Last. Guided by Best Practices.

Altivera develops advanced technologies and high-quality products to support patients throughout the
recovery process. Our solutions are built for real-world use, helping patients regain mobility and
progress confidently in their rehabilitation.

[See More Products][12]

## Supporting Patients at Every Step

Altivera provides tools and resources that help patients manage their therapy and recovery with
confidence.

[Clinic Store]

## Our Mission
* Providing innovative technologies
* Reducing pain and restoring function
* Optimizing patient outcomes

[Our mission]
[Our values]

## Our Values

Our values guide how we work, how we innovate, and how we support patients, clinicians, and
healthcare partners every day.

Patient Centric

We believe meaningful recovery starts with trusted support and a positive patient experience. We
advance technologies that restore function and prioritize practices that support and empower
patients so they can focus on what matters most: their health. Every innovation, decision, and
partnership begins with the question: Will this help patients move forward?

Win with Integrity & Compliance

We operate with transparency, accountability, and ethical discipline in everything we do. Trust is
earned through consistent actions, responsible conduct, and a commitment to doing what is right for
patients, clinicians, and partners.

Let Data Lead

We believe sound business and clinical decisions are grounded in facts, science, and measurable
outcomes. That's why we use data to guide our actions, leverage medical evidence to support clinical
decisions, and track outcomes to evaluate our impact.

Advance Together

Advancement in healthcare requires collaboration. We work alongside patients, clinicians, payors,
partners, and colleagues to elevate standards, share knowledge, and move recovery forward together.

Deliver on our Promises

We own our commitments and take responsibility for the impact and quality of our work.

Progress Through Innovation

We challenge conventional approaches to care, improving the experience for patients and clinicians.
At Altivera, innovation extends beyond products to include processes, systems, and ways of working.

## Work With Us

At Altivera, we are committed to improving lives through practical medical technology. Our teams
work across engineering, clinical research, operations, and patient support to develop solutions
that help patients recover and regain independence.

Introducing Altivera

# Elevating Performance. Advancing Recovery.

Altivera develops innovative medical technologies that help patients recover faster, restore
mobility, and live with less pain.

Backed by decades of experience, we support providers with reliable, patient-centered solutions
across every stage of recovery.

[Explore Our Products][7]

## Our Solutions

Altivera solutions support recovery through clinically proven, non-invasive solutions designed to
help patients manage pain, restore mobility, and continue progressing between clinical visits.

[
[Electrotherapy]

### Electrotherapy

Technologies designed to help relieve pain, stimulate muscle re-education, and support functional
recovery.

][8][
[Hot/Cold Compression]

### Hot/Cold Compression

Compression and temperature therapy designed to reduce inflammation, relieve discomfort, and promote
healing during recovery.

][9][
[Bracing & Traction]

### Bracing & Traction

Orthopedic support systems designed to stabilize joints, protect healing tissue, and support
recovery following injury or surgery.

][10]

## Built to Last. Guided by Best Practices.

Altivera develops advanced technologies and high-quality products to support patients throughout the
recovery process. Our solutions are built for real-world use, helping patients regain mobility and
progress confidently in their rehabilitation.

[See More Products][11]

## Built to Last. Guided by Best Practices.

Altivera develops advanced technologies and high-quality products to support patients throughout the
recovery process. Our solutions are built for real-world use, helping patients regain mobility and
progress confidently in their rehabilitation.

[See More Products][12]

## Supporting Patients at Every Step

Altivera provides tools and resources that help patients manage their therapy and recovery with
confidence.

[Clinic Store]

### Clinic Store

Order therapy products and accessories recommended by your healthcare provider.

[
[Patient Portal]

### Patient Portal

Access account information, manage therapy supplies, and stay connected with your care team.

][13][
[Complete Your Order]

### Complete Your Order

Finish device orders quickly and securely to begin therapy as soon as possible.

][14]

## Our Mission
* Providing innovative technologies
* Reducing pain and restoring function
* Optimizing patient outcomes

[Our mission]
[Our values]

## Our Values

Our values guide how we work, how we innovate, and how we support patients, clinicians, and
healthcare partners every day.

Patient Centric

We believe meaningful recovery starts with trusted support and a positive patient experience. We
advance technologies that restore function and prioritize practices that support and empower
patients so they can focus on what matters most: their health. Every innovation, decision, and
partnership begins with the question: Will this help patients move forward?

Win with Integrity & Compliance

We operate with transparency, accountability, and ethical discipline in everything we do. Trust is
earned through consistent actions, responsible conduct, and a commitment to doing what is right for
patients, clinicians, and partners.

Let Data Lead

We believe sound business and clinical decisions are grounded in facts, science, and measurable
outcomes. That's why we use data to guide our actions, leverage medical evidence to support clinical
decisions, and track outcomes to evaluate our impact.

Advance Together

Advancement in healthcare requires collaboration. We work alongside patients, clinicians, payors,
partners, and colleagues to elevate standards, share knowledge, and move recovery forward together.

Deliver on our Promises

We own our commitments and take responsibility for the impact and quality of our work.

Progress Through Innovation

We challenge conventional approaches to care, improving the experience for patients and clinicians.
At Altivera, innovation extends beyond products to include processes, systems, and ways of working.

## Work With Us

At Altivera, we are committed to improving lives through practical medical technology. Our teams
work across engineering, clinical research, operations, and patient support to develop solutions
that help patients recover and regain independence.

# About Esco Aster

Esco Aster is a vertically integrated bioinnovation venture accelerator delivering end-to-end
“idea-to-exit” contract solutions—from consultancy and research to CMC development, manufacturing,
testing, clinical development, business development, strategic capital and enterprise support.

We provide phase-appropriate capabilities that scale with our collaborators, sponsors, and partners
– from early development through GLP Tox, clinical, pilot, demonstration as a CRDMO / CDMO and full
commercial production (CMO).

Founded by scientists, we empower fellow innovators to translate benchwork and intellectual property
into real-world impact.

Through our platforms, we serve the broader bio-based deep tech bioeconomy—spanning life-saving
diagnostics, therapeutics, vaccines, dermatology, dermocosmetics/cosmeceuticals, medical aesthetics/
injectables/coatings, nutraceuticals, and cellular agriculture — delivering high-yield,
cost-effective solutions aligned with self-sufficiency and health technology assessment frameworks.

Our patented, best-in-class manufacturing platforms simplify complexity, enabling reliable, linearly
scalable outcomes. Our technologies have been successfully deployed in multiple commercial human and
animal vaccines, dermocosmetics, as well as in cell-based nutrition and clinical-grade stem cells
and exosomes.

We continuously invest in advancing manufacturing science to address unmet clinical needs, unlocking
bottlenecks across existing and emerging modalities from concept to cure.

Together with our venture ecosystem, we champion an interconnected One World. One Health
approach—bringing innovation to life for people, planet and profit.

Join us in redefining nutrition and medicine for current and future generations.

Esco Aster.
One World Biosolutions for One Health.

## About Us

Esco Aster was established in 2015 as an intrapreneurial venture within Esco Lifesciences Group,
following the successful commercialization and patenting of its proprietary biomanufacturing
platform—the packed-bed, adherent Tide Motion bioreactor.

Building on early technical validation achieving commercial success in human and animal vaccines and
market potential, Esco Aster was spun out in 2018 as a wholly owned subsidiary to accelerate product
development, strategic partnerships, and market expansion.

On 8 August 2022, Esco Aster completed its spin-off and now operates as an affiliate of Esco
Lifesciences Group, with increased strategic and operational independence to support its growth
trajectory.

Esco Lifesciences Group, headquartered in Singapore since 1978, was founded by a Singaporean
husband-and-wife team of pharmacists, both graduates of the National University of Singapore. The
Group has since evolved into a globally recognized life sciences platform with a strong track record
in innovation, manufacturing, and commercialization.

adherent cell and derivative patented Tide Motion platform.

Join us in the world we are making where clinical nutrition and medicine are reimagined-advancing
planetary health for current and future generations to come.

[ JOURNEY WITH US ][64]

Bioinnovation Venture Accelerator Bridging the translation Gap: Idea to Exit


Esco Aster is a biotech factory helping to spin out our existing Tide Motion bioprocess products
and/or services with the fastest time to clinic, using our standardized, linearly scalable
biomanufacturing platforms that are globally investable and backed by an exit strategy ensuring
returns to all stakeholders — from the public, founders, foundations, and nonprofits to financial
investors.

[ JOURNEY WITH US ][65]

cGMP CRDMO


cGMP-integrated contract research, development, and manufacturing organization. Esco Aster operates
two dedicated certified sites: one focused on clinical medicine, veterinary medicine, and
dermocosmetics; the other focused on clinical cell-based and derivative nutrition, and
nutricosmetics.

[ JOURNEY WITH US ][66]

Advancing the Future of Medicine Through Innovation


At Esco Aster, we empower the development of next-generation medicines by combining advanced
bioprocess solutions, translational research, and scalable manufacturing support. From discovery to
commercialization, we help innovators accelerate breakthroughs in biologics, cell and gene therapy,
vaccines, and regenerative medicine.

[ JOURNEY WITH US ][67]

Enabling Next-Generation Clinical Nutritional Solutions


Esco Aster provides cell-based products and derivatives for clinical and functional nutrition. These
include cell-based meats, proteins, fatty acids, collagen, and other high-value ingredients such as
bird’s nest, deer antler, mitochondria, and milk-/plant-derived extracellular vesicles for
nutraceuticals and supplements.

These products are developed for both companion animals and humans, ensuring clinical benefits for
improved skin health and gut microbiome function. This enables precision nutrition for cancer
patients as well as wellness and longevity applications aimed at increasing health span, not just
lifespan.

[ JOURNEY WITH US ][68]

Enterprise Solution


Esco Aster’s Enterprise Solutions offer a vertically integrated, one-stop framework for the
specialized design, construction, and validation of world-class life science and healthcare
facilities

[ JOURNEY WITH US ][69]

# About Esco Aster

Esco Aster is a vertically integrated bioinnovation venture accelerator delivering end-to-end
“idea-to-exit” contract solutions—from consultancy and research to CMC development, manufacturing,
testing, clinical development, business development, strategic capital and enterprise support.

We provide phase-appropriate capabilities that scale with our collaborators, sponsors, and partners
– from early development through GLP Tox, clinical, pilot, demonstration as a CRDMO / CDMO and full
commercial production (CMO).

Founded by scientists, we empower fellow innovators to translate benchwork and intellectual property
into real-world impact.

Through our platforms, we serve the broader bio-based deep tech bioeconomy—spanning life-saving
diagnostics, therapeutics, vaccines, dermatology, dermocosmetics/cosmeceuticals, medical aesthetics/
injectables/coatings, nutraceuticals, and cellular agriculture — delivering high-yield,
cost-effective solutions aligned with self-sufficiency and health technology assessment frameworks.

Our patented, best-in-class manufacturing platforms simplify complexity, enabling reliable, linearly
scalable outcomes. Our technologies have been successfully deployed in multiple commercial human and
animal vaccines, dermocosmetics, as well as in cell-based nutrition and clinical-grade stem cells
and exosomes.

We continuously invest in advancing manufacturing science to address unmet clinical needs, unlocking
bottlenecks across existing and emerging modalities from concept to cure.

Together with our venture ecosystem, we champion an interconnected One World. One Health
approach—bringing innovation to life for people, planet and profit.

Join us in redefining nutrition and medicine for current and future generations.

Esco Aster.
One World Biosolutions for One Health.

## About Us

Esco Aster was established in 2015 as an intrapreneurial venture within Esco Lifesciences Group,
following the successful commercialization and patenting of its proprietary biomanufacturing
platform—the packed-bed, adherent Tide Motion bioreactor.

Building on early technical validation achieving commercial success in human and animal vaccines and
market potential, Esco Aster was spun out in 2018 as a wholly owned subsidiary to accelerate product
development, strategic partnerships, and market expansion.

On 8 August 2022, Esco Aster completed its spin-off and now operates as an affiliate of Esco
Lifesciences Group, with increased strategic and operational independence to support its growth
trajectory.

Esco Lifesciences Group, headquartered in Singapore since 1978, was founded by a Singaporean
husband-and-wife team of pharmacists, both graduates of the National University of Singapore. The
Group has since evolved into a globally recognized life sciences platform with a strong track record
in innovation, manufacturing, and commercialization.

market-ready businesses.

**FEATURED INNOVATIONS**

**—— Improve Efficiencies and Achieve Better Outcomes with the Advanced Medical Technologies**

[foot drop treatment][foot drop treatment]

**Home Health Care**

**ENHANCE PERSONAL CAPABILITY TO MANAGE LYMPHEDEMA**

Innovative electrostatic oscillation device for lymphedema management. Handheld and simple to use,
PowerOsci LGT-2360S is suitable for professional and personal use.

[Learn more][44]

**Foot Drop**

**BETTER WALKING WITH WEARABLE FES DEVICE **

The difficulty in walking caused by MS impacts daily life. MStim Drop LGT-233 uses innovative FES
technology to help MS patients lift their drop foot normally.

[Learn more][45]

**Musculoskeletal Health**

**EMPOWERING THE BODY’S NATURAL HEALING ABILITY**

Our ESWT systems PowerShocker series make the treatment of acute soft tissue injuries and chronic
musculoskeletal conditions simple, efficient, and flexible.

[Learn more][46]

**DVT Prevention**

**EFFECTIVE DVT PREVENTION, REDUCED PREVENTABLE DEATHS**

Blood clots or DVT is a common, preventable, and life-threatening complication after surgery. Our
DVT pumps, small yet powerful, are well-suited to use in patient rooms to help patients reduce DVT
risk.

[Learn more][47]

**Mobility Restoration**

**THE RIGHT EXERCISE MAKES A BIG DIFFERENCE TO YOUR BODY**

The RehaMoto series provides safe, effective, and fun exercise for whoever is experiencing walking
difficulty and muscle weakness to improve their physical wellness and enhance their mood. 

[Learn more][48]

**Medical Aesthetics**

**ULTIMATE BODY AND SKIN REJUVENATION EXPERIENCE **

12-channel electrical stimulation machine with an additional pen electrode channel for more detailed
facial treatment. LGT-2320BE is designed to enhance your skin and body treatment practices. 

[Learn more][49]

**Tissue Recovery**

**TARGETS DEEPER TISSUES FOR EFFICIENT PAIN RELIEF AND RECOVERY**

LGT-3500GP is designed for clinics that require effective deep-tissue TECAR therapy in a compact
form. It focuses on muscles, joints, and deeper structures, supporting pain management,
post-operative rehabilitation, and sports recovery.

[Learn more][50]

**Surface Care**

**OPTIMIZED FOR SUPERFICIAL TISSUE STIMULATION AND GENTLE BIOHEATING**

LGT-3500LP is tailored for superficial and localized TECAR applications, and offers flexibility
while maintaining the core performance of the LGT-3500 series. Ideal for practices combining
rehabilitation and beauty applications.

[Learn more][51]

**Pelvic Floor Rehabilitation**

**SIGNIFICANTLY ENHANCE PELVIC FLOOR MUSCLE STRENGTH AND NERVE COORDINATION IN A SHORT TIME**

The LGT-2640AP Magnetic Stimulator is a non-invasive medical device specifically designed to treat
pelvic floor and urinary system disorders.

[Learn more][52]

**Musculoskeletal Rehabilitation**

**EFFECTIVELY REGULATE NEUROMUSCULAR FUNCTION**

The LGT-2660AP/BP Electromagnetic Stimulator is a non-invasive medical device. This  stimulation
directly targets deep-seated nerves, muscles, and bones, effectively regulating neuromuscular
function, accelerating tissue repair, and alleviating pain at its source. It delivers  comfortable
stimulation to support local fat reduction, muscle toning, and cellulite improvement. Available in
single-channel (LGT-2660AP) and dual-channel (LGT-2660BP) configurations. 

Learn more

**Body Shaping**

**FOR FAT LOSS AND BODY SHAPING**

The LGT-2650BP Body Shaping Magnetic Stimulator is a professional aesthetic rehabilitation device
designed for targeted fat reduction and muscle firming. It has precise and adjustable depth
positioning for specific fat/muscle layers, is compatible with radiofrequency, and enhances shaping
effects. It is suitable for a wide range of users, including those who are obese, overweight, or
have the need for bodybuilding muscles.

 

Learn more

with more and more medical providers worldwide.

[
Focused shockwave therapy, musculoskeletal repair
Focused shockwave therapy machine uses high-energy sound waves (i.e. focused shockwaves) to
accurately act on the affected area, penetrate 4-66mm into the tissue, stimulate cell metabolism and
microcirculation, promote vascular regeneration and collagen production, thereby accelerating the
repair of soft tissues such as muscles, tendons, and ligaments. Shockwaves can also interfere with
the conduction of pain signals, reduce the sensitivity of nerve endings, and significantly relieve
acute and chronic pain. Equipped with 7 different working heads, it can adapt to the treatment needs
of multiple parts and multiple depths, and is often used for sports injuries and chronic pain
management.
][59]
[
448K thermal penetration therapy, CET+RET+PAD
TECAR therapy uses 448KHz radio frequency (RF) thermal penetration therapy, combined with CET, RET
and innovative PAD flat electrode technology, deep heating of tissues, activation of cell metabolism
and microcirculation, and significant relief of muscle pain and joint stiffness. As a passive
electrode, the PAD board has a wide coverage area and is easy to use. It can stably release energy
and enhance treatment efficiency. It is suitable for large-area fat reduction and body shaping. It
promotes fat decomposition and lymphatic detoxification through deep thermal effects. It is safe and
non-invasive, and is an ideal choice for combining physical therapy with weight loss and beauty.
][60]
[
Joint flexibility, pemf magnetic therapy machine
The magnetic therapy machine uses pulsed electromagnetic field (PEMF) technology to act on animal
joints and surrounding tissues, stimulate cell activity, and enhance local blood and lymphatic
circulation. It accelerates soft tissue repair, reduces joint inflammation and swelling, promotes
synovial fluid production, improves joint lubrication, and reduces friction. Ultimately, joint
flexibility and range of motion are significantly improved. It helps maintain joint health and
improves overall mobility and athletic performance.
][61]
[
Pain Relief, Physiotherapy Machine
Magnetic therapy uses pulsed electromagnetic field (PEMF) technology to stimulate body tissues in a
non-invasive way, restore cellular electrical balance, enhance blood circulation, and promote
metabolism. Accelerate tissue repair and reduce inflammation. Electromagnetic pulses penetrate deep
into the body, modulate nerve signals and reduce nerve excitability, helping to relieve
inflammation, improve blood circulation, and pain caused by injuries or chronic diseases. Better
removal of waste and toxins.
][62]
[
Lymphatic detoxification, compression therapy
The air pressure suit uses multi-channel (24 air channels) dynamic compression technology to
simulate professional massage techniques, rhythmically squeeze and release the body limbs, promote
lymph flow and venous return, help the body to discharge waste and toxins, and achieve lymphatic
detoxification and edema relief. Combined with far-infrared thermal therapy technology, it deeply
heats the subcutaneous tissue, accelerates blood circulation, activates fat metabolism, enhances
cell vitality, and helps fat burning and shaping. This device integrates massage, detoxification,
and weight loss, and is widely used in body care, postoperative recovery and health management.
][63]

[
Focused shockwave therapy, musculoskeletal repair
Focused shockwave therapy machine uses high-energy sound waves (i.e. focused shockwaves) to
accurately act on the affected area, penetrate 4-66mm into the tissue, stimulate cell metabolism and
microcirculation, promote vascular regeneration and collagen production, thereby accelerating the
repair of soft tissues such as muscles, tendons, and ligaments. Shockwaves can also interfere with
the conduction of pain signals, reduce the sensitivity of nerve endings, and significantly relieve
acute and chronic pain. Equipped with 7 different working heads, it can adapt to the treatment needs
of multiple parts and multiple depths, and is often used for sports injuries and chronic pain
management.
][59]
[
448K thermal penetration therapy, CET+RET+PAD
TECAR therapy uses 448KHz radio frequency (RF) thermal penetration therapy, combined with CET, RET
and innovative PAD flat electrode technology, deep heating of tissues, activation of cell metabolism
and microcirculation, and significant relief of muscle pain and joint stiffness. As a passive
electrode, the PAD board has a wide coverage area and is easy to use. It can stably release energy
and enhance treatment efficiency. It is suitable for large-area fat reduction and body shaping. It
promotes fat decomposition and lymphatic detoxification through deep thermal effects. It is safe and
non-invasive, and is an ideal choice for combining physical therapy with weight loss and beauty.
][60]
[
Joint flexibility, pemf magnetic therapy machine
The magnetic therapy machine uses pulsed electromagnetic field (PEMF) technology to act on animal
joints and surrounding tissues, stimulate cell activity, and enhance local blood and lymphatic
circulation. It accelerates soft tissue repair, reduces joint inflammation and swelling, promotes
synovial fluid production, improves joint lubrication, and reduces friction. Ultimately, joint
flexibility and range of motion are significantly improved. It helps maintain joint health and
improves overall mobility and athletic performance.
][61]
[
Pain Relief, Physiotherapy Machine
Magnetic therapy uses pulsed electromagnetic field (PEMF) technology to stimulate body tissues in a
non-invasive way, restore cellular electrical balance, enhance blood circulation, and promote
metabolism. Accelerate tissue repair and reduce inflammation. Electromagnetic pulses penetrate deep
into the body, modulate nerve signals and reduce nerve excitability, helping to relieve
inflammation, improve blood circulation, and pain caused by injuries or chronic diseases. Better
removal of waste and toxins.
][62]
[
Lymphatic detoxification, compression therapy
The air pressure suit uses multi-channel (24 air channels) dynamic compression technology to
simulate professional massage techniques, rhythmically squeeze and release the body limbs, promote
lymph flow and venous return, help the body to discharge waste and toxins, and achieve lymphatic
detoxification and edema relief. Combined with far-infrared thermal therapy technology, it deeply
heats the subcutaneous tissue, accelerates blood circulation, activates fat metabolism, enhances
cell vitality, and helps fat burning and shaping. This device integrates massage, detoxification,
and weight loss, and is widely used in body care, postoperative recovery and health management.
][63]
[
ems vacuum physical therapy machine, muscle fatigue
The EMS vacuum sponge cup combines electrostimulation (EMS) and vacuum negative pressure technology.
Through the sponge cup, it fits the skin, gently absorbs and conducts pulse current, stimulates
passive muscle contraction, activates deep muscle groups, and effectively relieves muscle soreness
and fatigue caused by sitting for a long time. Vacuum negative pressure can promote local blood and
lymphatic circulation, help lactic acid metabolism, reduce edema, relax tense muscles, and improve
stiffness. The device supports 10 groups of simultaneous use, which is suitable for synchronous
conditioning of multiple parts. It is an efficient physical therapy tool for relieving physical
fatigue and enhancing muscle vitality.
][64]

## **HUR for Aged Care**                                                                            
                                                                                                    
Providing exercise opportunities for our oldest citizens may be a fairly new concept for some but   
the evidence is clear from all around the world – the way to fight frailty is through physical and  
mental strength training.                                                                           
                                                                                                    
With HUR equipment even the frailest can exercise in a safe and rewarding way and so maintain or    
even recover the ability to live independently.                                                     
                                                                                                    
Gyms with HUR equipment and places where miracles happen every day.                                 
                                                                                                    
Ready to see the equipment? [**Click here.**][30]                                                   
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

## **“#1 Inclusive Wellness and Rehabilitation”**

 

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
## **HUR for rehabilitation**                                                                       
                                                                                                    
Periods of inactivity are bad for us. Our muscles weaken alarmingly quickly and joints stiffen.     
                                                                                                    
The earlier that rehab can be safely started the better the outcomes will be and so the benefits of 
zero starting load and “natural transmission” through air resistance are easy to see. With HUR      
pneumatic resistance rehab can be safely started as soon as movement is allowed.                    
                                                                                                    
Safety features such as range limiters and the ability to exercise left-right independently, along  
with measurable range-of-motion and power output mean progress is safe and meaningful. SmartTouch   
software means all progress is evidence based.                                                      
                                                                                                    
[**Click here**][31] to learn more about rehabilitation and reablement.                             
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

## **“Once you are doing exercise regularly, the hardest thing is to stop it.”**
## – Erin Gray

 

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
## **HUR for Inclusive Wellness**                                                                   
                                                                                                    
The needs of wheelchair users have not been ignored at HUR. Dedicated wheelchair-friendly equipment 
is included in our strength training range.                                                         
                                                                                                    
What’s more, all of the ‘Easy-Access’ range is also suitable for non-wheelchair users so whether you
are looking to develop a gym dedicated to wheelchair users or want to provide a gym for all, we have
the equipment range to meet your needs.                                                             
                                                                                                    
Ready to see the equipment? **[Click here][32]**.                                                   
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

## **“It matters not how long we live but how”**

## – Philip James Bailey

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
## **HUR for Wellness teams**                                                                       
                                                                                                    
Our innovative products give you and your team an edge. Easy client management through intelligent, 
cloud-based, software allows for efficiency, productivity and wellness.                             
                                                                                                    
Create and manage clients’ training programmes, monitor individual progress and track outcomes      
across time, peer groups and locations, all from one friendly interface.                            
                                                                                                    
Attractive, safe and silent equipment enhances your village or facility and provides a point of     
difference for your marketing.                                                                      
                                                                                                    
Ready to see the equipment? **[Click here][33]**.                                                   
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

## **“How old would you be if you didn’t know how old you are?”**
## – Satchel Paige

 

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
## **HUR for Senior Managers**                                                                      
                                                                                                    
If you are looking for your gym to do more than just look after the gym junkies of this world, HUR  
has you covered.                                                                                    
                                                                                                    
A gym powered by HUR is not only the best place for promoting wellbeing, it is also the best place  
for promoting your facility.                                                                        
                                                                                                    
Not only do gyms with HUR equipment give you a point of difference from your competitors but they   
are also well-used gyms and well-used gyms are great for organic marketing through word-of-mouth.   
                                                                                                    
The automation of exercising through individualised programmes and electrically adjusting machines  
means reduced allied health costs and the automated data collection and reporting from our software 
means easy and reliable reporting of improvements to funding authorities.

## **HUR for Aged Care**                                                                            
                                                                                                    
Providing exercise opportunities for our oldest citizens may be a fairly new concept for some but   
the evidence is clear from all around the world – the way to fight frailty is through physical and  
mental strength training.                                                                           
                                                                                                    
With HUR equipment even the frailest can exercise in a safe and rewarding way and so maintain or    
even recover the ability to live independently.                                                     
                                                                                                    
Gyms with HUR equipment and places where miracles happen every day.

## **HUR for rehabilitation**                                                                       
                                                                                                    
Periods of inactivity are bad for us. Our muscles weaken alarmingly quickly and joints stiffen.     
                                                                                                    
The earlier that rehab can be safely started the better the outcomes will be and so the benefits of 
zero starting load and “natural transmission” through air resistance are easy to see. With HUR      
pneumatic resistance rehab can be safely started as soon as movement is allowed.                    
                                                                                                    
Safety features such as range limiters and the ability to exercise left-right independently, along  
with measurable range-of-motion and power output mean progress is safe and meaningful. SmartTouch   
software means all progress is evidence based.

## The Innovative Approach to Exercise

HUR’s strength, balance, and testing solutions are specifically designed to provide safe, targeted
training and testing appropriate for a diverse range of ability and stamina levels. Thanks to 35
years of close cooperation with leading researchers in biomechanics and exercise physiology, our
product lines are the culmination of three key innovations: [NaturalTransmission™][74], [Intelligent
Exercise Technology][75], and [State-of-the-Art Equipment][76].

[Senior Living & Active Ageing][77]
[Rehabilitation & Medical][78]
[Accessible Training][79]
[Sport Rehab & Performance][80]
[Wellness Gyms][81]
[Universities & Schools][82]

## Natural Transmission™ with Air Resistance

HUR machines operate using a pneumatic (air resistance) system. Natural Transmission™ is designed to
emulate the natural movement patterns of muscles, facilitating safe and efficient training at any
speed. With integrated lever arms, the system dynamically adjusts resistance to match the natural
force generation of your muscles. This allows for more intense training sessions while minimizing
the risk of injury.

[Read more][83]

## HUR SmartTouch – Intelligent Exercise Technology

HUR SmartTouch stands at the global forefront of evidence-based training and management solutions,
serving individuals, clinics, and wellness centers alike. With HUR SmartTouch technology, each HUR
machine transforms into an intelligent, interconnected, and fully integrated computerized exercise
system.

[Read more][84]

## State-of-Art Equipment

HUR equipment is crafted based on the latest, university-level research and technological
advancements. We are committed to ensuring that each machine withstands the test of time and
continuously evolves alongside the ever-advancing world of exercise.

[Read more][85]

## The Innovative Approach to Exercise

HUR’s strength, balance, and testing solutions are specifically designed to provide safe, targeted
training and testing appropriate for a diverse range of ability and stamina levels. Thanks to 35
years of close cooperation with leading researchers in biomechanics and exercise physiology, our
product lines are the culmination of three key innovations: [NaturalTransmission™][74], [Intelligent
Exercise Technology][75], and [State-of-the-Art Equipment][76].

[Senior Living & Active Ageing][77]
[Rehabilitation & Medical][78]
[Accessible Training][79]
[Sport Rehab & Performance][80]
[Wellness Gyms][81]
[Universities & Schools][82]

## Natural Transmission™ with Air Resistance

HUR machines operate using a pneumatic (air resistance) system. Natural Transmission™ is designed to
emulate the natural movement patterns of muscles, facilitating safe and efficient training at any
speed. With integrated lever arms, the system dynamically adjusts resistance to match the natural
force generation of your muscles. This allows for more intense training sessions while minimizing
the risk of injury.

[Read more][83]

## HUR SmartTouch – Intelligent Exercise Technology

HUR SmartTouch stands at the global forefront of evidence-based training and management solutions,
serving individuals, clinics, and wellness centers alike. With HUR SmartTouch technology, each HUR
machine transforms into an intelligent, interconnected, and fully integrated computerized exercise
system.

[Read more][84]

## State-of-Art Equipment

HUR equipment is crafted based on the latest, university-level research and technological
advancements. We are committed to ensuring that each machine withstands the test of time and
continuously evolves alongside the ever-advancing world of exercise.

[Read more][85]

HUR strength equipment is trusted worldwide in senior living communities, rehabilitation clinics,
and accessible wellness environments.

HUR’s pneumatic resistance technology provides smooth, joint-friendly strength training adaptable
for every ability level. Trusted across active aging communities, senior living environments,
rehabilitation centers, and accessible fitness spaces, **HUR helps people build strength, improve
balance, and maintain independence for life.**

## **The Problem** with Outdated Strength Equipment
* Loss of Strength

Muscle loss begins around age 30 and can accelerate over time.  
* Unsafe / Intimidating Equipment

Traditional equipment can be intimidating and hard on joints, which discourages consistent use.
* Lack of Accessibility

Most equipment isn’t designed for limited mobility, creating barriers for many.
* Declining Quality of Life

Without effective training, people risk losing the confidence and strength needed to stay active and
connected.

## Frequently Asked Questions about HUR Strength Equipment

### Who is HUR equipment designed for?

HUR equipment is designed for active aging adults, rehabilitation patients, and individuals needing
accessible, safe, and low-impact strength training. Using pneumatic (air-powered) resistance, it is
ideal for seniors and those with limited mobility, offering near-zero starting loads and smooth
movement that is gentle on joints.

### What makes HUR different from traditional weight machines?

HUR equipment uses pneumatic (air-powered) resistance instead of weight stacks, creating a smoother,
quieter, and more joint-friendly exercise experience. Unlike traditional machines, HUR allows for
near-zero starting loads and very small resistance increases, making it ideal for beginners,
seniors, and rehabilitation settings while still being effective for strength development.

### What is pneumatic resistance?

Pneumatics (or pneumatic resistance) refers to technology that uses compressed air, rather than
traditional iron weight stacks, to provide resistance for strength training and rehabilitation. This
creates safer, smoother, and more accessible equipment designed to match the body’s natural force
curve, allowing for near-zero load starts and fine-tuned resistance increases.

senior fitness. It uses RFID technology (wristband/card) to automatically load personalized exercise

resistance, and progression over time. This allows trainers and clinicians to generate detailed

tissue conditions.

circulation, and assist recovery in physical therapy and rehabilitation settings.

circulation, support soft tissue recovery, and enhance rehabilitation efficiency.

# MADE IN USA

## With domestic and globally sourced materials

[Headshot of Dennis Keiser in outdoor setting]
**“While our competitors are losing their manufacturing skills, we’re perfecting ours.”** DENNIS
KEISER CEO, Keiser Corporation

## Family values

The values we learned growing up on the farm run through our company — a sense of integrity,
dedication to work, and a commitment to one another. First and foremost, Keiser is a family company.

## Keeping jobs at home

We decided a long time ago, we couldn’t send our jobs overseas. So, we designed our machines to be
built at home. And we built a team that believes in Keiser, its mission, and each other to meet our
high standards.

## Owning our technology

We’ve always designed and built our own products. We don’t just design our machines to work better,
we make them to be better. And we keep our technology at home to give you the finest in
American-made quality.

## Perfecting our manufacturing

To compete with low-cost, foreign manufacturing, we’ve leaned out our processes and honed our
manufacturing skills. It hasn’t been easy, but while our competitors are losing their manufacturing
skills, we’re perfecting ours.

# MADE IN USA

## With domestic and globally sourced materials

[Headshot of Dennis Keiser in outdoor setting]
**“While our competitors are losing their manufacturing skills, we’re perfecting ours.”** DENNIS
KEISER CEO, Keiser Corporation

## Family values

The values we learned growing up on the farm run through our company — a sense of integrity,
dedication to work, and a commitment to one another. First and foremost, Keiser is a family company.

## Keeping jobs at home

We decided a long time ago, we couldn’t send our jobs overseas. So, we designed our machines to be
built at home. And we built a team that believes in Keiser, its mission, and each other to meet our
high standards.

## Owning our technology

We’ve always designed and built our own products. We don’t just design our machines to work better,
we make them to be better. And we keep our technology at home to give you the finest in
American-made quality.

## Perfecting our manufacturing

To compete with low-cost, foreign manufacturing, we’ve leaned out our processes and honed our
manufacturing skills. It hasn’t been easy, but while our competitors are losing their manufacturing
skills, we’re perfecting ours.

About Us
Kostech is a reliable manufacturer, supplier, and trader offering cost-effective Beauty Therapy
Machine, Portable Q-Switch ND Yag Laser Machine, Kostech Electric Bed Warmer, Facial Kit, Derma Bed,
and more.

Our product line comprises high-tech beauty therapy machines, one of which is the Portable Q-Switch
ND Yag Laser Machine. It provides precision and efficiency in skin treatments. Specialized
equipment, such as the Kostech Electric Bed Warmer, Facial Kits, and Derma Beds, are also provided
to make the treatment process comfortable and effective. All the equipment are made using the latest
technology and materials to ensure high performance, durability, and ease of use.

Our company cares for all its customers and has established high standards on the quality and safety
of products. Our focused employees are committed to achieving customer desires and implementing
appropriate solutions according to the specific needs of each customer. We therefore would like to
ensure not only superior products but also sound customer care service with timely delivery and
post-sales support.

We believe in innovation and quality. And that is the reason why Kostech was able to expand its
domestic reach and expand further into international territories. Kostech is the go-to brand in the
beauty and wellness industry that offers premium solutions that are both reliable and efficient.

**Why Us?**

Whether you are a professional who needs reliable tools for your clinic or an individual looking to
upgrade your space, we have the best beauty and wellness solutions for all. Browse through our
products and find out how we can help you achieve your objectives.

* Proven Track Record: More than 10 years of dedication to quality and customer satisfaction.
* Innovative Technology: Continuous investment in research and development to stay ahead of the
  curve in trends in the industry.
* Team: Experienced team of engineers, designers, and beauty experts working to create impactful
  solutions.
* International Reach: Working with clients from all over the world for trusted products and
  high-quality service.
* Customer focused: We appreciate feedback and relations are maintained long-term.

About Us
Kostech is a reliable manufacturer, supplier, and trader offering cost-effective Beauty Therapy
Machine, Portable Q-Switch ND Yag Laser Machine, Kostech Electric Bed Warmer, Facial Kit, Derma Bed,
and more.

Our product line comprises high-tech beauty therapy machines, one of which is the Portable Q-Switch
ND Yag Laser Machine. It provides precision and efficiency in skin treatments. Specialized
equipment, such as the Kostech Electric Bed Warmer, Facial Kits, and Derma Beds, are also provided
to make the treatment process comfortable and effective. All the equipment are made using the latest
technology and materials to ensure high performance, durability, and ease of use.

Our company cares for all its customers and has established high standards on the quality and safety
of products. Our focused employees are committed to achieving customer desires and implementing
appropriate solutions according to the specific needs of each customer. We therefore would like to
ensure not only superior products but also sound customer care service with timely delivery and
post-sales support.

We believe in innovation and quality. And that is the reason why Kostech was able to expand its
domestic reach and expand further into international territories. Kostech is the go-to brand in the
beauty and wellness industry that offers premium solutions that are both reliable and efficient.

**Why Us?**

Whether you are a professional who needs reliable tools for your clinic or an individual looking to
upgrade your space, we have the best beauty and wellness solutions for all. Browse through our
products and find out how we can help you achieve your objectives.

* Proven Track Record: More than 10 years of dedication to quality and customer satisfaction.
* Innovative Technology: Continuous investment in research and development to stay ahead of the
  curve in trends in the industry.
* Team: Experienced team of engineers, designers, and beauty experts working to create impactful
  solutions.
* International Reach: Working with clients from all over the world for trusted products and
  high-quality service.
* Customer focused: We appreciate feedback and relations are maintained long-term.

## Frequently Asked Questions?

Clear answers to the most common questions customers ask before choosing the right physiotherapy
equipment for their clinic or practice.

#### What is physiotherapy equipment used for?

Physiotherapy equipment includes electrotherapy and rehabilitation devices used by trained
professionals to manage pain, restore movement, improve muscle function, and support post-injury or
post-surgical recovery in clinical settings.

#### Are you a manufacturer or a supplier of physiotherapy equipment?

KTM Medical Devices operates as a manufacturing brand under KTM Medical Devices, with equipment
produced through a controlled, in-house manufacturing process in India, India. Core production,
testing, and quality checks are handled internally.

#### Where is your physiotherapy equipment manufactured?

All equipment under the KTM Medical Devices brand is manufactured in India, India, with structured
production workflows designed to meet both domestic and international supply requirements.

#### How do I choose the right physiotherapy machine for my clinic or hospital?

Selection depends on patient volume, treatment protocols, clinical objectives, and available space.
Our team assists healthcare providers by recommending equipment configurations aligned with daily
clinical usage and long-term operational needs.

#### Are your physiotherapy machines clinically tested?

Yes. Each unit undergoes functional testing, calibration checks, and operational verification before
dispatch to ensure safety, accuracy, and suitability for professional therapeutic use.

#### Do you provide installation and operational guidance?

Yes. We support buyers with installation coordination and basic operational guidance, ensuring
equipment is correctly set up for clinical environments.

#### What is the typical delivery timeline for physiotherapy equipment?

Delivery timelines depend on product category and order volume. Our in-house manufacturing structure
allows predictable production scheduling, enabling reliable dispatch timelines for both domestic and
export orders.

#### Do you offer after-sales service and spare support?

Yes. KTM Medical Devices supports long-term service coordination and spare availability, helping
clinics and institutions maintain equipment performance over time.

#### Do you supply physiotherapy equipment outside India?

Yes. We supply equipment to Dubai (UAE), Saudi Arabia, and African markets, supported by
export-ready specifications, packaging standards, and documentation processes.

#### Is your equipment suitable for hospitals and high-usage environments?

Yes. Equipment is designed for continuous professional usage in hospitals, rehabilitation centers,
and multi-patient clinical setups, focusing on durability and operational stability.

#### Can medical distributors partner with KTM Medical Devices?

Yes. We work with medical equipment distributors and institutional buyers seeking consistent
manufacturing supply, export support, and long-term collaboration.

#### How can I request product details or a catalogue?

You can connect with our team to request a product catalogue, technical specifications, or
commercial information based on your clinic, hospital, or distribution requirements.

Clear answers to the most common questions customers ask before choosing the right physiotherapy

#### What is physiotherapy equipment used for?

Physiotherapy equipment includes electrotherapy and rehabilitation devices used by trained
professionals to manage pain, restore movement, improve muscle function, and support post-injury or
post-surgical recovery in clinical settings.

#### Are you a manufacturer or a supplier of physiotherapy equipment?

KTM Medical Devices operates as a manufacturing brand under KTM Medical Devices, with equipment
produced through a controlled, in-house manufacturing process in India, India. Core production,
testing, and quality checks are handled internally.

#### Where is your physiotherapy equipment manufactured?

All equipment under the KTM Medical Devices brand is manufactured in India, India, with structured
production workflows designed to meet both domestic and international supply requirements.

Selection depends on patient volume, treatment protocols, clinical objectives, and available space.
Our team assists healthcare providers by recommending equipment configurations aligned with daily
clinical usage and long-term operational needs.

Yes. KTM Medical Devices supports long-term service coordination and spare availability, helping
clinics and institutions maintain equipment performance over time.

#### Do you supply physiotherapy equipment outside India?

Yes. We supply equipment to Dubai (UAE), Saudi Arabia, and African markets, supported by
export-ready specifications, packaging standards, and documentation processes.

#### Is your equipment suitable for hospitals and high-usage environments?

Yes. Equipment is designed for continuous professional usage in hospitals, rehabilitation centers,
and multi-patient clinical setups, focusing on durability and operational stability.

#### Can medical distributors partner with KTM Medical Devices?

Yes. We work with medical equipment distributors and institutional buyers seeking consistent
manufacturing supply, export support, and long-term collaboration.

Longest medical works to provide high-quality, cost-effective, and durable physiotherapy equipment,
aesthetic equipment, and rehabilitation devices that are extensively used in sports physiotherapy,
neurological rehabilitation, orthopedics, post-surgical recovery, musculoskeletal physiotherapy,
pain management, and aesthetic medicine.

[28th Madrid World Congress ISMST]
[FDA Approves Longest LGT-2320 Low-Frequency NMES/TENS Devices]
[Longest Medical KEY-products 2026]
[Precision Cold,Optimal Pain Relief]
[Advanced ESWT Device,Enhanced Musculoskeletal Health]
[3 in 1 Combo,Expanded Treatment Capability]
[professional shockwave therapy machine LGT-2500X (1)]
Veterinary Extracorporeal Shockwave Therapy Device PowerShocker LGT-2500X Vet

PowerShocker LGT-2500X Vet is a compressed pneumatic ballistic shockwave therapy device, bringing
the most advanced way to treat musculoskeletal disorders in animals with quality, speed, and ease.
With premium features and a sleek design, it is a premier solution for veterinary clinics to
streamline workflow, increase efficiency, and improve animal care.

[Veterinary Extracorporeal Shockwave Therapy Device PowerShocker LGT-2500X Vet][117]
[The LGT-2660 Series Electromagnetic Stimulator]
Electromagnetic Stimulator for Musculoskeletal Rehabilitation LGT-2660AP/BP

The LGT-2660 Series Electromagnetic Stimulator for Musculoskeletal Pain is an advanced
rehabilitation device engineered to address a wide range of musculoskeletal pain conditions and
associated dysfunctions. Operating on the principle of electromagnetic induction, it generates
induced currents to regulate neuromuscular function while delivering deeply penetrating energy—this
energy transcends superficial tissues to act directly on muscles, joints, and bones. For both acute
and chronic musculoskeletal pain, it provides a safe, efficient, and medication-free new solution.

[Electromagnetic Stimulator for Musculoskeletal Rehabilitation LGT-2660AP/BP][118]
[Electromagnetic Stimulator for Body Shaping]
Electromagnetic Stimulator for Body Shaping LGT-2650BP

The LGT-2650BP is a premium unisex body contouring device. Powered by high-intensity magnetic
stimulation, it induces intense muscle contractions—effectively boosting muscle tone while reducing
stubborn fat deposits. It is widely suited for weight management, body shaping, and individuals with
excess weight alike.

[Electromagnetic Stimulator for Body Shaping LGT-2650BP][119]
[Electromagnetic Stimulator LGT-2640AP for Pelvic floor rehabilitation]
Electromagnetic Stimulator for Pelvic floor rehabilitation LGT-2640AP

The LGT-2640AP Pelvic Floor Magnetic Stimulator is a precision rehabilitation device designed for
targeted pelvic floor therapy. Featuring 24 visualized preset protocols (paired with anatomical
diagrams), customizable treatment plans, and a pre-adaptation function, it delivers non-invasive,
painless stimulation to support postpartum recovery, male pelvic floor rehabilitation, and geriatric
pelvic health. 

[Electromagnetic Stimulator for Pelvic floor rehabilitation LGT-2640AP][120]
[High-Frequency Therapy Device LGT-3500GP]
High-Frequency Therapy Device LGT-3500GP（Desktop Design）

LGT-3500GP fits tight spaces without sacrificing performance. Equipped with full TECAR tech, dual
tissue-targeting modes, and core safety features, it handles post-op rehab, shallow tissue care, and
more—lightweight, durable, and perfect for space-conscious facilities.

[High-Frequency Therapy Device LGT-3500GP（Desktop Design）][121]
[High Frequency Therapy 3500LP]
High Frequency Therapy Device LGT-3500LP(Upright Design)

 The LGT-3500LP has an upright design with plenty of storage and rolling casters for easy mobility.
It uses TECAR Therapy, and it has dual CET/RET modes, 300 KHz~1 MHz frequencies, and safety features
like real-time temperature monitoring. This gives you precise, efficient treatments for deep tissue
repair and pain relief.

[High Frequency Therapy Device LGT-3500LP(Upright Design)][122]
[rehab-bike-for-upper-and-lower-limbs-rehamoto-lgt-5100d 2]
Rehab Bike for Upper and Lower Limbs, Active-Passive Trainer (APT) RehaMoto LGT-5100D Config II

The RehaMoto LGT-5100D Config II is a rehabilitative training device designed to facilitate both
active and passive movements of a person's lower and upper limbs. This device features four training
modes: active-passive training, assistive training, symmetry training, and isokinetic training.
Additionally, it is equipped with multiple protection functions, including spasm control, emergency
stop, max. speed control, and speed setting prompt.

[Rehab Bike for Upper and Lower Limbs, Active-Passive Trainer (APT) RehaMoto LGT-5100D Config
II][123]
[rehab-bike-for-upper-and-lower-limbs-rehamoto-lgt-5100D]
Rehab Bike for Upper and Lower Limbs, Active-Passive Trainer (APT) RehaMoto LGT-5100D

RehaMoto controls the servo motor through the central processing unit and the biomechanical
monitoring feedback system. Users can do passive, assisted, active, and constant-speed training by
RehaMoto LGT-5100D Config I. The intelligent identification device realizes real - time monitoring
of user training status and smooth conversion between different modes. Fully realize the best
clinical training effect, and promote the recovery of users' motor function.

[Rehab Bike for Upper and Lower Limbs, Active-Passive Trainer (APT) RehaMoto LGT-5100D][124]
[Air Compression Therapy Device]
IPC Pump Lymphatic Drainage Massage Device LGT-2210DS

The LGT-2210DS is a cutting-edge IPC pump and air compression therapy device, designed to elevate
service standards in physiotherapy, rehabilitation, and cosmetology clinics. It delivers seamless,
comfortable gradient and sequential pneumatic compressions to effectively enhance blood and lymph
flow. Supporting 4-chamber/6-chamber leg/arm cuffs and 24-chamber full-body cuffs, it offers
versatile, precise treatment for diverse needs.

[IPC Pump Lymphatic Drainage Massage Device LGT-2210DS][125]
[Combination Therapy Machine Ultrasound and Electrotherapy Device LGT-2900EUV]
Combination Therapy Machine Ultrasound and Electrotherapy Device LGT-2900EUV

The LGT-2900EUV Ultrasound Electrotherapy Machine is a remarkable all-in-one device that integrates
ultrasound, electrotherapy, and vacuum therapy. With its modular design, it offers up to three
different modules in a single compact unit, enabling independent or combined treatments of multiple
modalities in one device. This design not only improves efficiency and reduces costs but also
enhances the effects of pain relief, tissue repair, and muscle function recovery through synergistic
effects.

[Combination Therapy Machine Ultrasound and Electrotherapy Device LGT-2900EUV][126]
[lgt-2200dvt]
Effective Gradient Compression DVT Pump LGT-2200DVT

The LGT-2200DVT is a compression therapy device comprised of an intermittent pneumatic controller
(main unit), sleeves, and a connection hose. Its working principle is that air inflates and deflates
the sleeves sequentially to generate circulating pressure on the human body. By squeezing the
proximal and distal limbs, it can directly or indirectly promote blood circulation and the lymphatic

workflow efficiency and enhance patient care.

Deep Vein Thrombosis (DVT) Compression Therapy Device LGT-2201DVT

LGT - 2202DVT DVT Pump for Hospitals

The LGT-2202DVT is a gradient-pressure compression therapy system engineered to lower the risk of

PowerShocker LGT-2500X Vet is a compressed pneumatic ballistic shockwave therapy device, bringing
the most advanced way to treat musculoskeletal disorders in animals with quality, speed, and ease.
With premium features and a sleek design, it is a premier solution for veterinary clinics to
streamline workflow, increase efficiency, and improve animal care.

[The LGT-2660 Series Electromagnetic Stimulator]
Electromagnetic Stimulator for Musculoskeletal Rehabilitation LGT-2660AP/BP

The LGT-2660 Series Electromagnetic Stimulator for Musculoskeletal Pain is an advanced
rehabilitation device engineered to address a wide range of musculoskeletal pain conditions and
associated dysfunctions. Operating on the principle of electromagnetic induction, it generates
induced currents to regulate neuromuscular function while delivering deeply penetrating energy—this
energy transcends superficial tissues to act directly on muscles, joints, and bones. For both acute
and chronic musculoskeletal pain, it provides a safe, efficient, and medication-free new solution.

[Electromagnetic Stimulator for Musculoskeletal Rehabilitation LGT-2660AP/BP][118]
[Electromagnetic Stimulator for Body Shaping]
Electromagnetic Stimulator for Body Shaping LGT-2650BP

The LGT-2650BP is a premium unisex body contouring device. Powered by high-intensity magnetic
stimulation, it induces intense muscle contractions—effectively boosting muscle tone while reducing
stubborn fat deposits. It is widely suited for weight management, body shaping, and individuals with
excess weight alike.

[Electromagnetic Stimulator for Body Shaping LGT-2650BP][119]
[Electromagnetic Stimulator LGT-2640AP for Pelvic floor rehabilitation]
Electromagnetic Stimulator for Pelvic floor rehabilitation LGT-2640AP

The LGT-2640AP Pelvic Floor Magnetic Stimulator is a precision rehabilitation device designed for
targeted pelvic floor therapy. Featuring 24 visualized preset protocols (paired with anatomical
diagrams), customizable treatment plans, and a pre-adaptation function, it delivers non-invasive,
painless stimulation to support postpartum recovery, male pelvic floor rehabilitation, and geriatric
pelvic health. 

[Electromagnetic Stimulator for Pelvic floor rehabilitation LGT-2640AP][120]
[High-Frequency Therapy Device LGT-3500GP]
High-Frequency Therapy Device LGT-3500GP（Desktop Design）

LGT-3500GP fits tight spaces without sacrificing performance. Equipped with full TECAR tech, dual
tissue-targeting modes, and core safety features, it handles post-op rehab, shallow tissue care, and
more—lightweight, durable, and perfect for space-conscious facilities.

[High-Frequency Therapy Device LGT-3500GP（Desktop Design）][121]
[High Frequency Therapy 3500LP]
High Frequency Therapy Device LGT-3500LP(Upright Design)

 The LGT-3500LP has an upright design with plenty of storage and rolling casters for easy mobility.
It uses TECAR Therapy, and it has dual CET/RET modes, 300 KHz~1 MHz frequencies, and safety features
like real-time temperature monitoring. This gives you precise, efficient treatments for deep tissue
repair and pain relief.

[High Frequency Therapy Device LGT-3500LP(Upright Design)][122]
[rehab-bike-for-upper-and-lower-limbs-rehamoto-lgt-5100d 2]
Rehab Bike for Upper and Lower Limbs, Active-Passive Trainer (APT) RehaMoto LGT-5100D Config II

The RehaMoto LGT-5100D Config II is a rehabilitative training device designed to facilitate both
active and passive movements of a person's lower and upper limbs. This device features four training
modes: active-passive training, assistive training, symmetry training, and isokinetic training.
Additionally, it is equipped with multiple protection functions, including spasm control, emergency
stop, max. speed control, and speed setting prompt.

[Rehab Bike for Upper and Lower Limbs, Active-Passive Trainer (APT) RehaMoto LGT-5100D Config
II][123]
[rehab-bike-for-upper-and-lower-limbs-rehamoto-lgt-5100D]
Rehab Bike for Upper and Lower Limbs, Active-Passive Trainer (APT) RehaMoto LGT-5100D

RehaMoto controls the servo motor through the central processing unit and the biomechanical
monitoring feedback system. Users can do passive, assisted, active, and constant-speed training by
RehaMoto LGT-5100D Config I. The intelligent identification device realizes real - time monitoring
of user training status and smooth conversion between different modes. Fully realize the best
clinical training effect, and promote the recovery of users' motor function.

[Rehab Bike for Upper and Lower Limbs, Active-Passive Trainer (APT) RehaMoto LGT-5100D][124]
[Air Compression Therapy Device]
IPC Pump Lymphatic Drainage Massage Device LGT-2210DS

The LGT-2210DS is a cutting-edge IPC pump and air compression therapy device, designed to elevate
service standards in physiotherapy, rehabilitation, and cosmetology clinics. It delivers seamless,
comfortable gradient and sequential pneumatic compressions to effectively enhance blood and lymph
flow. Supporting 4-chamber/6-chamber leg/arm cuffs and 24-chamber full-body cuffs, it offers
versatile, precise treatment for diverse needs.

[IPC Pump Lymphatic Drainage Massage Device LGT-2210DS][125]
[Combination Therapy Machine Ultrasound and Electrotherapy Device LGT-2900EUV]
Combination Therapy Machine Ultrasound and Electrotherapy Device LGT-2900EUV

The LGT-2900EUV Ultrasound Electrotherapy Machine is a remarkable all-in-one device that integrates
ultrasound, electrotherapy, and vacuum therapy. With its modular design, it offers up to three
different modules in a single compact unit, enabling independent or combined treatments of multiple
modalities in one device. This design not only improves efficiency and reduces costs but also
enhances the effects of pain relief, tissue repair, and muscle function recovery through synergistic
effects.

[Combination Therapy Machine Ultrasound and Electrotherapy Device LGT-2900EUV][126]
[lgt-2200dvt]
Effective Gradient Compression DVT Pump LGT-2200DVT

The LGT-2200DVT is a compression therapy device comprised of an intermittent pneumatic controller
(main unit), sleeves, and a connection hose. Its working principle is that air inflates and deflates
the sleeves sequentially to generate circulating pressure on the human body. By squeezing the
proximal and distal limbs, it can directly or indirectly promote blood circulation and the lymphatic
system, improve body micro-circulation, prevent thrombi, and reduce limb swelling. It addresses
diseases related to blood and lymph circulation. It is widely used in hospital settings to improve
workflow efficiency and enhance patient care. 

[Effective Gradient Compression DVT Pump LGT-2200DVT][127]
[LGT-2201DVT]
Deep Vein Thrombosis (DVT) Compression Therapy Device LGT-2201DVT

The LGT-2201DVT is a compression therapy device. It is composed of an intermittent pneumatic

clinics and hospitals.

## Main Content

[Three young children dressed as superheroes standing proudly in a paediatric occupational therapy
clinic, representing confidence-building and imaginative play as part of child and family centred
therapy. Banner includes awards for customer service and workplace excellence, and Great Place to
Work certification]

 

### Complex Developmental Support for Under 9’s

[[Complex Developmental Support for Preschool & Early Primary Years (0-8 Year Olds)]][25]

If your child is under 9 and needs a high level of support to participate safely and meaningfully in
everyday life, contact MoveAbout to talk about whether occupational therapy may be the right fit for
your family.

### Supporting 9-12 Year Olds (Upper Primary)

[[Supporting the Primary School Years (9-12 Year Olds)]][26]

If your child is aged 9–12 and everyday life is feeling harder than it should, occupational therapy
intervention at MoveAbout can help.

### Building Independence for 13-18 Year Olds

[[Building Independence for Teens (13-18 Year Olds)]][27]

Teenagers need support that respects their age, interests and goals. At MoveAbout, we ensure that
therapy should feels practical, respectful and connected to real life.

### Getting Started

[[Getting Started]][28]

The therapy process begins with you contacting our office. We will ask some questions to ensure we
are the right place and determine who would be best to support you.

**GET IN TOUCH**

[Contact us][29]

children across NSW with clinics in Sydney, the Central Coast and Newcastle regions.

a subsidiary of GenScript Biotech Corporation, is a global Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) that accelerates the discovery, development, and commercialization of biologics and advanced therapies. Combining innovative discovery platforms with integrated development and GMP manufacturing capabilities, ProBio provides end-to-end solutions across antibodies, recombinant proteins, plasmid DNA, mRNA, viral vectors, and in vivo CAR-T therapies. From target discovery and lead optimization through process development, clinical supply, and commercial manufacturing, ProBio helps partners advance complex programs with speed, quality, and confidence. Its scalable technology platforms, global manufacturing network, and deep scientific expertise enable efficient progression from concept to clinic and beyond. Through a collaborative, risk-sharing approach, ProBio also offers flexible licensing and co-development opportunities, helping biotech and pharmaceutical companies reduce development risk, accelerate timelines, and bring innovative therapies to patients faster. ### Contact us For more information about our company and services, please feel free to reach out to our team. ## Why Redcord?
* Clinically validated enhancement of neuromuscular activation, the Neurac® method.
* Systematic exercise assessment using standardized multi-graded and multi-directional test
  protocols.
* Identification of weak links—pain, incoordination, or neuromuscular weakness—targeting key kinetic
  chains.
* Elastic unloading enabling pain-free, sub-threshold, and fine-graded therapeutic exercise.
* Precisely adjustable suspension instability to elicit high neuromuscular demand.
* Core-activating suspension exercise progressions across all major movement planes.
* Vibration input that improves pain-modulating, muscle activating, and coordination.
* Interchangable slings for precise, comfortable, and targeted support.
* Designed for segmental control of the core — integrated with coordination of the limbs.
* Flexible control of kinetic-chain length and involvement.

## WHO WE ARE

Welcome to **ZH WorldTrade** — a professional China Reliable wholesale supplier built to serve
retailers and resellers around the world.

With over **10 years of experience** in global trade, we have grown from a dedicated local supplier
into a trusted cross-border wholesale partner, serving **500+ active clients** across **50+
countries**. Our foundation is simple: deliver quality products, fair prices, and reliable service —
every single order.

We specialize in the wholesale supply of general merchandise, offering **3,000+ SKUs** across four
core categories:
* 🛒 **Daily Necessities** — Everyday essentials that move fast and sell consistently
* 🏠 **Home Goods** — Practical and lifestyle products for modern living
* 🔌 **Electronics Accessories** — High-demand tech accessories for online and offline retail
* 👗 **Apparel & Accessories** — Fashion-forward pieces at wholesale-friendly prices

Whether you’re an independent online seller, a brick-and-mortar retailer, or a large-scale buyer
placing bulk orders — we have the inventory and flexibility to meet your needs.

[ZH WorldTrade company view China Factory Supplier]

## Value-added services

[China Reliable wholesale supplier global shipment]

Professional Global shipment and custom clearance.

[China Reliable wholesale supplier inspection service]

1-by-1 Product Inspection
Factory & Supplier Audit

[China Reliable wholesale supplier warehouse]

Free Warehousing & Storage
makes your business more flexible

**FAQ：**

**Q: What is your minimum order quantity (MOQ)?**

Our standard MOQ starts from 10 pieces per SKU. For mixed product orders across multiple categories,
the minimum total order value is $100. We understand that small and medium retailers need
flexibility, so we work hard to accommodate your specific needs — feel free to reach out and we’ll
find a solution that works for you.

**Q: How do you ensure product quality before shipment?**

Every order goes through our in-house quality control process before it leaves our warehouse. We
conduct item-by-item inspections covering product dimensions, packaging integrity, labeling
accuracy, and function testing where applicable. For high-value or large-volume orders, we also
offer third-party inspection services through certified agencies upon request.

**Q: Which countries do you ship to?**

We ship to 50+ countries worldwide, including the United States, United Kingdom, Canada, Australia,
Germany, France, the UAE, and across Southeast Asia. We work with major freight forwarders and
express couriers including DHL, FedEx, UPS, and sea freight carriers to find the most cost-effective
shipping solution for your destination.

**Q: How long does shipping take?**

Shipping time depends on your chosen method. Express courier (DHL/FedEx) typically takes 5–7
business days. Air freight takes approximately 10–15 days. Sea freight (LCL or FCL) takes 20–40 days
depending on your port. We always provide full tracking information and proactive shipping updates
throughout the process.

**Q: Do you support OEM, private label, or custom packaging?**

Yes. We support custom logo printing, private label packaging, and OEM production for qualifying
order quantities. Whether you need your brand name on the product, customized box design, or product
modifications, our sourcing team can connect you with the right manufacturer and manage the entire
process on your behalf.

**Q: How do I place an order or get a quote?**
